items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Lewis Armstrong is one of them. That's right. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I like all the spiritual hymns, but they sing. It's good.

ctx.x: Well there's none particular, I like all of them. Everything he ever made I like.
Lewis Armstrong is one of them. That's right. And what spirituals do you like?
I like all the spiritual hymns, but they sing. It's good.
